what: Privacy filter for synthetic twins: every twin line vs every real line. Counts and thresholds only.
calibration: Thresholds calibrated on the 46k-line owner export: on 891 independent synthetic lines (data/published/reader/test.jsonl, never derived from real data) the fixture defaults flagged 16.0% (reverse containment, real lines >=12 grams) and 5.4% (8-gram containment from 15 chars) - chance overlap, not copying. With min_real_grams 30 and min_chars_ngram 30 the false-positive rate is 1.0% and 2.0%; embedding (from 15 chars), exact (from 12) and PII tests are unchanged.
